description: The Louis Vuitton Alma is the house's structured, dome-shaped top-handle bag: a firm rounded silhouette with a flat base, a short handle and a zip that follows the curve of the top. It traces back to 1934, designed under Gaston-Louis Vuitton and named for the Place de l'Alma in Paris, and it is still made today across Epi leather (the original material), Monogram canvas, Damier and glossy Monogram Vernis. It comes in a size ladder from Nano and BB up through PM, MM and GM, so one Alma can range from a palm-sized mini to a roomy tote.
note: 1934 = article-#34-verified heritage anchor (design origin, Place de l'Alma). Replaces the tier placeholder stub.
